claims.evidence: Witness photo shows only a close-up of tread/sidewall with no readable brand/model markings and no readable tyre size/DOT/date code.

risks.risk: Tyre size may not match (width/aspect/rim), affecting fitment on the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the exact size text (e.g., 295/40 R20) and any additional markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used tyre with unknown exact size/fitment risk.

risks.risk: Brand/model claim may be wrong ("tukubo" not readable), affecting expected quality and resale value.
risks.proof: A close, sharp shot of the sidewall brand/model lettering (and any model/series code).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded/unknown-brand used tyre.

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining life are unknown; witness only notes worn tread and patchy scuffing.
risks.proof: A tread-depth measurement (e.g., gauge reading) plus a full circumference photo set (both sides).

risks.risk: Possible damage not visible in the single close-up (cuts, bulges, cracks) could make it unsafe or unrepairable.
risks.proof: Photos/video showing the entire sidewall and tread from multiple angles, including close-ups of any suspected cuts/cracks/bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/unsafe until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Repair/patch/plug status and whether it holds air are unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of any repair marks plus a short clip showing it inflated/holding air (or a valve-core check).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to hold air (worst-case).

risks.risk: Age/DOT date is unknown; older tyres can be brittle even if tread remains.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT/manufacturing date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used stock with unknown age.

proof_requests: Send a clear, readable photo of the full sidewall showing the exact size (295/40 R20) and brand/model text.
Send a photo of the DOT/manufacturing date code.
Provide tread-depth measurements (gauge reading) at multiple points and a full circumference photo set (both sides).
Show the entire sidewall for cuts/cracks/bulges (multiple angles) and confirm whether it has any repairs (plug/patch).
Provide proof it holds air: a short video/clip of the tyre inflated and stable (or a pressure reading).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a car tyre with worn tread, but the key details needed to price it correctly (exact size/brand, DOT date, tread depth, and safety/air-holding condition) are not readable or not shown in the provided report.
